# x402-transit

> Transit trip planning and live delay snapshots from open GTFS/GTFS-RT feeds, priced per query

x402-transit is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/x402-transit/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
